rubric.role_summary: Remote permit operations lead overseeing construction permit applications, customer updates, compliance, process improvements, and junior team members.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote permit operations lead overseeing construction permit applications, customer updates, compliance, process improvements, and junior team members.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of relevant experience in construction permitting, project management, or a similar role.
- Hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting.
- Background in customer success, customer experience, or sales.
- People-management experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in a SaaS or tech-driven environment.
- Experience managing permitting projects across multiple states or regions.
- 2+ years leading, managing, and mentoring teams, including coaching, performance management, and team development.
- Extensive hands-on experience in construction or construction permitting, with understanding of regulations, compliance, and the full permit lifecycle.
- Understanding of permitting processes, regulations, compliance standards, and jurisdictional differences.
- Project management ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines.
- Ability to manage a team, including one-on-ones, training, coaching, feedback, and direction.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): USA; Greater Toronto, Ontario, Canada area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
